answer: Give every identity one marble: a non-transferable work token earned only by finishing a public task that random peers attest. Marbles pool in a shared lagoon, and weight drains like a tide unless refreshed by fresh attested work. A zephyr of new fakes arrives weightless, so spinning up a thousand accounts buys nothing: each fake must do real, graded work to earn even one marble, and the cost scales with every sockpuppet.
